note: NOTE: This template is a working structure, not a final specification — follow it to the best of your ability and report any areas or commands that need improvement after use.
shared: Match the attached reference's art style, design, materials, palette and proportions exactly; with no reference, use felt-plush storybook character art for 2D animation. Plain transparent background; if transparency is unavailable, use one perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) with no gradient, shading or glow anywhere on it, and no magenta in the character. No text, labels, frames, shadows or props. Nothing touches a cell or canvas edge. Clean solid silhouette edge with no loose fibres or specks. Every drawing of the character keeps the same design, palette, proportions and scale.
stance: Animation-ready stance: standing upright, feet planted shoulder-width apart with a clear gap of background between the legs from the crotch to the floor, arms held slightly away from the body (about 20 degrees) with a clear gap between each arm and the body, hands open, head level. Every limb is fully visible and not overlapping another limb.

new.label: New character
new.layout: One full-body front view, centred horizontally, about 1300 px tall, feet on a baseline at y = 1440.

image.label: Redraw for animation
image.layout: Redraw the attached character exactly (same design, colours, clothing, materials) as one full-body front view, centred horizontally, about 1300 px tall, feet on a baseline at y = 1440.

sheet.label: Turnaround sheet
sheet.layout: Four views of the attached character in one row of four equal cells (384 x 1024 px each), left to right: front, right profile, back, left profile. Each figure about 880 px tall, feet on one shared baseline at y = 960, same scale in every cell.

poses.label: Pose sheet
poses.layout: Six poses of the attached character in a grid of 3 columns x 2 rows of equal cells (512 x 512 px each): idle, walk, jump, wave, talk, cheer.

actions.label: Action frames
actions.layout: {frames} consecutive animation frames of the attached character performing {action}, {view}, in a grid of 4 columns x 2 rows of equal cells (384 x 512 px each): {keys}.

walk.keys: contact, down, passing, up, contact, down, passing, up

run.keys: contact, down, push-off, flight, contact, down, push-off, flight

jump.keys: stand, crouch, take-off, rise, apex, fall, squash, recover

wave.keys: rest, arm rising, hand up, wave left, wave right, wave left, wave right, lowering

turn.keys: front, 3/4 right, right profile, 3/4 back right, back, 3/4 back left, left profile, 3/4 left

sing.keys: rest, inhale, mouth open, high note, arm sweep, full extension, return, settle

layers.label: Overlapping layers
layers.layout: The attached character separated into cut-out animation parts in a 3x3 grid of 512x512 cells: head; torso; near upper arm; near forearm; far upper arm; far forearm; near leg; far leg; empty cell.

parts_chroma.label: Chroma-green parts sheet (#00FF00)
parts_chroma.layout: Exploded 2D puppet disassembly parts sheet of the attached character on a flat solid chroma-green (#00FF00) background in 6 non-overlapping regions with rounded overlap caps at each joint.
parts_chroma.shared_override: Match the attached reference's art style, design, materials, palette and proportions exactly. Use ONE perfectly flat solid pure chroma-green (#00FF00) background with no gradient or shadow.

poses_2x2.label: 2x2 Character pose sheet (4 poses)
poses_2x2.layout: Four full-body poses of the attached character in a 2x2 grid of 512x512 cells: idle, talk_sing, walk_hop, celebration wave.

cutout_rig.label: Character Rig Pack (character + chroma parts + 2x2 poses)
cutout_rig.layout: Three-part character bundle (front cutout, #00FF00 chroma parts sheet, 2x2 pose sheet) ingested into assets/characters/<id>/.
